The mechanism of the vitamin-K-dependent carboxylation reaction is unknown.
biotin does not appear to play a role in the carboxylation of proteins in the vitamin K cycle.

the elucidation of the mechanisms of the vitamin K dependent post-translational modification of proteins.
the elucidation of the mechanism by which the gamma-carbon of glutamic acid is carboxylated in the post-translational modification of certain proteins.
the vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation of certain glutamate residues in vitamin K-dependent proteins.
